description:
*"A curse! On the birthday of the year he comes of age, the prince will prick his finger on the spindle of a spinning wheel and fall into a long sleep. Only a true love's kiss will awaken the prince from his slumber..."*

Cursed by the evil sorceress Veronica, the unfortunate Prince Leo is put under a curse, but the curse is a little... clumsy? What does the prince encounter when he awakens from his sleep?!

**Original Manhwa:**
